thought.text: All artifacts check out. Let me run a negative login test (wrong password must be rejected) and compare schema table count with the live database.

reasoning_content:
All good. `install/sql/schema.sql` has 138 tables — the DB table count also matches at 138. Let me check whether the schema table count matches the DB (compare `grep -c 'CREATE TABLE'` in schema.sql).

Also, to verify that login is actually authenticating against the password (i.e., not letting anyone through), let's do a negative test — try logging in with a wrong password. This is an important check to prove that the admin password is actually functional.

Furthermore, let's verify the daemon's log activity (does the daemon write to var/log?) and confirm that the daemon process is running as the qisutu user (already confirmed in ps). In addition, let's check the schema's CREATE TABLE count against 138.

action.command: cd /tmp && curl -s http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl -o bad-index.html && CSRF=$(grep -oE 'name="CSRFToken" value="[^"]*"' bad-index.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//') && curl -s -c badcookie.txt -b badcookie.txt -D bad-headers.txt -o bad-after.html -X POST http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl --data-urlencode "CSRFToken=$CSRF" --data-urlencode "Step=Login" --data-urlencode "AccountType=agent" --data-urlencode "Language=en" --data-urlencode "Login=admin" --data-urlencode "Password=wrongpassword123" && head -1 bad-headers.txt; grep -c QISUTU_SESSION bad-headers.txt; grep -oiE '(Invalid|Wrong|ungültig|falsch)[^<]{0,50}' bad-after.html | head -3
